user.title: Connect to AAT Multiroom
user.description: Enter the IP address of the AAT Multiroom amplifier on your local network.

naming.title: Name the equipment, zones and inputs
naming.description: Detected model: {model} ({zones} zone(s)). Give a name to the equipment, each zone and each audio input. You can rename these later from "Configure".

reconfigure.title: Update the Multiroom's address
reconfigure.description: Use this if the unit's IP address changed. Zone/input names and entity history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Multiroom at this address/port.

init.title: Rename zones and inputs
init.description: Update the names of this Multiroom's zones and audio inputs.

unknown_command.message: The device did not recognize the command "{command}" (error code 7).

device_off.message: The device must be powered on to accept the command "{command}" (error code 8).

invalid_zone_or_value.message: The device rejected the command "{command}": invalid zone or value out of range (error code 17).

value_out_of_range.message: The device rejected the command "{command}": value out of range (error code 18).

command_failed.message: The device rejected the command "{command}" (error code {code}).

connection_error.message: Communication with the Multiroom failed while running "{command}": {error}
